title: The Promise with Ye Qing
next_chapter_hook: Before Ye Qing left, she whispered, 'The next time we meet, we will be true partners of destiny.' — The faint, haunting fragrance lingering in the air was still hers, but Chen Ji had already begun deducing every possible variable of this night.

text.content: The golden light from the fourth page of the Tianji Record had not yet fully faded, but Chen Ji had already gathered his thoughts, his fingertips brushing lightly over those words. 'The fourth page is a key, yet also the final shackle' — his father's riddle, seven parts understood. Outside the window, the night wind suddenly rose, carrying with it a cold aura not belonging to the Tianqing Sect. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly as he spoke, neither loud nor soft: 'Since you're here, why stand beneath the eaves in the wind?'

dialogue.content: Under the moonlight, a figure in black gauze drifted silently into the window like a falling leaf. Ye Qing, the Holy Sect's Saint, removed her hood, revealing a cold, frost-like, breathtakingly beautiful face, with a blood-red mole between her brows that seemed eerily captivating under the silver light. 'Chen Ji, you have quite the nerve, speaking up knowing I'm here.' Her voice carried a hint of amusement, 'Or has your Tianji Record already 'seen' that I was coming?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, merely pouring himself a cup of cold tea and pushing it across to the other side. His movements were unhurried, as if the person across from him was not the Holy Sect's Saint, but an old friend of many years. Ye Qing's eyes flickered, studying this disciple rumored to be worthless. His gaze was too calm — so calm it reminded her of an abyss, serene on the surface, with something unfathomable lurking beneath.

dialogue.content: 'What does it matter whether I saw or not?' Chen Ji raised his eyes, a faint smile playing at the corners of his lips. 'Your visit must surely not be to exchange pleasantries with a waste like me.' He paused, his gaze falling upon the blood mole between her brows. 'Or could it be that the Holy Sect is pressing you again?'

Ye Qing's hand paused ever so slightly. This waste actually knew the movements of the Holy Sect? She suppressed the turbulence in her heart, her expression betraying nothing. 'You are well-informed indeed.' She leaned forward, meeting Chen Ji's gaze directly. 'Since that's the case, I'll be direct — I wish to make a deal with you.'

text.content: Moonlight streamed through the window lattice, carving a silver line between them. Chen Ji said nothing, merely lifting his teacup to blow upon it gently. That composure annoyed Ye Qing inexplicably. She had seen too many so-called geniuses — under the name of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, they either groveled or raged. Only this man before her was neither afraid nor proud, as if her purpose had already been laid bare to him.

dialogue.content: 'The Holy Sect wants my blood,' Ye Qing's voice suddenly dropped, the blood mole between her brows seeming to pulse slightly. 'They need the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key' to activate the ancient forbidden formation. And I... am merely a blade they have raised.' Her gaze grew distant. 'I investigated your Tianji Record, Chen Ji — can that thing let me see my own fate?'

text.content: Chen Ji set down his teacup and finally displayed the first genuine smile of the evening. That smile held no mockery, yet it sent a chill down Ye Qing's spine. 'You want to see fate?' His voice drifted lightly. 'The clearer you see fate, the faster you die.' He rose and walked to the window, his back to her. 'Are you certain you want to pay that price?'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proactively reveals herself to express sincere desire for cooperation. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, honestly communicate the price
choices.description: Show Ye Qing the partial truth foreseen by the Tianji Record, making her understand what the price of cooperation entails

dialogue.content: 'Very well, I'll let you see a vision.' Chen Ji turned around, pressing his fingertip onto the fourth page of the Tianji Record. A beam of golden light sank into Ye Qing's brow center — she saw her own ending, her blood drained as a sacrifice by the Holy Sect, while Chen Ji stood in the distance, watching it all happen. 'This is the price you asked me for.' His voice was soft. 'Did you see it clearly?'

Ye Qing's eyes snapped open, cold sweat beading on her forehead. She stared at Chen Ji intensely, her voice trembling: 'You saw this long ago?' Chen Ji gave no answer, simply draining the cup of cold tea in one gulp. After a long moment, Ye Qing suddenly laughed, the sound carrying a bitter edge: 'So in this chess game, I'm not even worth a single piece.'

text.content: But Ye Qing was, after all, the Holy Sect's Saint; within moments she had gathered herself, a resolute gleam flickering in her eyes: 'Since the ending is set, then let's rewrite it.' She met Chen Ji's gaze directly. 'The deal you mentioned — what is it?'

choices.memory_label: 夜清被陈机展示的命运所震撼

choices.text: Hide one's trump card, seduce with profit
choices.description: Don't reveal the specific abilities of the Tianji Record, only discuss the points of mutual interest, maintain the advantage of mystery
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may develop wariness due to information asymmetry

dialogue.content: 'The deal is simple.' Chen Ji turned back, his gaze profound. 'You have the Holy Sect's intelligence network; I have... other means.' He did not explain what these 'other means' were. 'We cooperate, each taking what we need. Equal exchange, honest and fair.'

Ye Qing narrowed her eyes: "Other means?" Chen Ji smiled without answering, merely raising his hand lightly and drawing a诡异的 trajectory in the void. Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply—that was the incantation gesture of a Demonic Path forbidden technique. How could a disciple of the Tianqing Sect know such a thing?

text.content: "Some things don't need explanation." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his tone as casual as commenting on the weather. "You only need to know that I have the ability to keep you alive. And you can save me a lot of trouble." After a long silence, Ye Qing finally nodded: "Deal."

choices.memory_label: 夜清被陈机的神秘手段震慑

dialogue.content: "Cooperation? The ambition is too small." Chen Ji suddenly said something unexpected to Ye Qing. "I have a proposal—the Destiny Twin Protocol." He watched Ye Qing's bewildered expression and explained: "Our bloodlines are connected, our fates shared. If you die, I perish too; if I fall, you cannot survive."

Ye Qing drew a sharp breath. She had seen records of such a pact in Demonic Path classics—it was a technique used by ancient powerhouses to bind sworn brothers in life and death. "You're insane?" She stared at Chen Ji. "Aren't you afraid I'll turn on you?" Chen Ji smiled, a smile that sent chills down Ye Qing's spine: "Would you?"

text.content: Ye Qing fell into a long silence. Under the moonlight, she gazed at the man before her—his eyes were too clear, clear as an ancient well with no bottom visible. She suddenly understood: "You... never intended to live alone, did you?" Chen Ji did not answer, only extending his hand: "Holy Maiden, what's your decision?"

flags_set: 夜清被陈机的决绝震撼
choices.memory_label: 夜清意识到陈机身上背负着比她更重的命运

text.content: In the end, Ye Qing reached out and interlaced her fingers with his. An uncanny blood resonance surged between the two, as if some ancient pact was awakening. Ye Qing felt a wave of dizziness, and Chen Ji before her suddenly became achingly real—his pain, his scheming, the madness and despair hidden beneath his calm exterior, all flooded into her perception.

dialogue.content: "You..." Ye Qing's voice trembled slightly; she hadn't expected the perception sharing of the Destiny Twin Protocol to be so intense. She instinctively tried to pull back her hand, but Chen Ji held it tighter. "Don't move." Chen Ji's voice was also tense. "The first establishment of connection—if forcibly severed, it will damage the soul."

text.content: Within the blood resonance, Chen Ji sensed Ye Qing's inner struggle and fear. She was not afraid of death, but of being used and then discarded like refuse. How many years had it been? She had navigated carefully within the Holy Sect, yet she had always been a chess piece ready to be abandoned at any moment. And now, this man whose circumstances were even more desperate than hers, was actually willing to place his fate in her hands.

dialogue.content: After the blood connection stabilized, Ye Qing slowly opened her eyes, her gaze toward Chen Ji incomprehensibly complex. "Who exactly are you?" Her voice was low. "A废物 servant of the Tianqing Sect couldn't possibly possess such techniques." Chen Ji released her hand and stepped back: "Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is, from now on, we share life and death."

text.content: Ye Qing suddenly laughed, the smile carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Share life and death... In my ten years at the Holy Sect, no one has dared speak such words to me." She raised her hand, her fingertip gently touching Chen Ji's heart. "Chen Ji, you better pray you won't regret this." Her finger was ice-cold, yet Chen Ji remained unmoved.

dialogue.content: "Regret?" Chen Ji grasped the finger pointing at his heart, not moving away. "Ye Qing, I never regret in this life." His voice was soft, yet carried an unsettling certainty. "The only thing I regret is that I kill my enemies too slowly." Ye Qing was stunned; at this moment, she suddenly realized—this man before her was more dangerous than any Demonic Path overlord she had ever encountered.

text.content: The night wind outside the window suddenly ceased, as if even heaven and earth were holding their breath. Chen Ji released Ye Qing's hand, walked to the table, picked up the cold tea, and drained it in one gulp. "The tea has gone cold." He said, his tone like commenting on today's weather. Ye Qing watched him, suddenly feeling her throat tighten—why, when he could have easily manipulated her, did he choose the most clumsy method?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice several degrees softer than before. "Aren't you afraid I came to test you? That the Holy Sect has set something on me?" Chen Ji turned around, looking at her, the corner of his lips slightly raised: "I am afraid. But your fear just now was real." He paused. "Seeing that kind of expression on the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path... worth it."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his hand, gently brushing the blood mole between Ye Qing's brows. "This thing... I will help you remove it." His voice was soft, yet inexplicably reassuring. "When I obtain the complete key, I will find a method to解除 your internal restriction." Ye Qing was stunned—how many years had it been since anyone had said such words to her.

text.content: "Are you lying to me?" Ye Qing's voice was somewhat hoarse. Chen Ji shook his head: "I never lie. It's just... some truths can only be told when the time is right." He stepped back, "Tonight's business ends here. When you return, if the Holy Sect asks, just say you came to probe me and found nothing."

dialogue.content: "It's getting late." Chen Ji's tone suddenly cooled, "Please return, Saint Lady, before someone discovers you." Ye Qing froze—how could this gentle man change his face so suddenly? What she didn't know was that Chen Ji had already sensed her wavering through the blood connection. Showing moderate gentleness was a tactic, but revealing everything was a grave mistake.

text.content: Ye Qing gave him a deep look, as if wanting to say something, but ultimately swallowed her words. She turned toward the window, her black纱 fluttering in the night wind. Before leaving, she suddenly turned back: "Chen Ji, I will remember you." Chen Ji clasped his hands: "I'm honored by the Saint Lady's remembrance."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing." Chen Ji suddenly called out to her, "There's one thing I can tell you—your sister Chen Nian is still alive." Ye Qing's footsteps paused, and she turned around, a complex light flickering in her eyes. Chen Ji smiled: "The Holy Sect didn't kill her. She's now imprisoned in a place you would never imagine. When the time is right, I'll tell you how to rescue her."

text.content: Ye Qing stared fixedly at Chen Ji, as if trying to find some flaw in his face. But that face was terrifyingly calm, leaving her unable to judge whether it was true or false. "Who exactly are you?" she asked again, her voice now carrying a hint of trembling. Chen Ji didn't answer, simply watching her leave.

choices.memory_label: 陈机透露陈念下落，夜清震惊

text.content: After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone by the window. The night wind rose again, carrying a wisp of faint, ethereal fragrance. He lowered his gaze to his palm—when connected with Ye Qing through blood, he had sensed her loneliness and despair, and that heartstring she had been touched by.

The lingering resonance of the fourth page of the Tianji Record had not yet fully dissipated when Chen Ji suddenly laughed softly: "Fate's twins... Father, you truly know how to give me difficult problems." He opened the Tianji Record and looked at that line of text—"The fourth page is the key, but also the final shackle." He finally understood; this shackle was not for others, but for himself.

Chen Ji closed the Tianji Record and shut his eyes. Through the blood connection just now, he could sense Ye Qing moving away from the Tianqing Sect. Her emotions were turbulent—vigilance, confusion, and also a trace of... anticipation she herself hadn't noticed. His lips curved slightly: "Anticipation?" he murmured to himself, "Then look forward to it."

The night wind grew cold, and the moon reached its zenith. Chen Ji turned back to the table, poured out the cold tea, and refilled a cup of hot tea. A soft sound came from outside the window—a completely black homing pigeon landed on the windowsill, a note tied to its leg. Chen Ji removed the note, unfolded it, and his gaze slightly narrowed: "Ling Yuan... you're finally making your move."

dialogue.content: At the same time, dozens of miles outside the Tianqing Sect in the night sky, a figure in black纱 rode the wind. Ye Qing lowered her gaze to her palm—the spot where their blood had connected during the bloodline connection still seemed to retain a trace of warmth. "Chen Ji..." she murmured to herself, suddenly remembering those eyes she had glimpsed before leaving. Those eyes were too clear, so clear it made her heart palpitate.

text.content: She suddenly remembered Chen Ji's murmured words before he left—"The next time we meet, we will be true partners in destiny." The night wind brushed past, and she shivered. After this night, the bond between her and that man could probably never be severed again. Whether for fortune or misfortune, she didn't know. But there was one thing she was certain of—this man who was worse than useless was far more dangerous than anyone she had ever encountered.

Before Ye Qing left, she murmured: 'The next time we meet, we will be true partners in destiny'—the ethereal fragrance lingering on her body still remained in the air, yet Chen Ji had already begun deducing all the possible variables of this night. The moonlight was like water, the cold tea had already grown cold, and the undercurrents within the Tianqing Sect were quietly stirring.
